**<picture><img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/review-comment-icons-v1/major-16.svg" width="16" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift**

**Fall back to the Outcome comment when the lock guard cannot read the locks.**

`completeStory` runs after the merge, at Line 582 of `runShip`. The body PATCH now goes through `lockGuard`. Before the PATCH is sent, `lockGuard` reads every `missions/*/plan.json` from the ledger (`missionLocks` → `readPlans`). If that read fails, `lockGuard` returns an `ExitExternal` error, not a `lockRefusal`. Two cases cause this: a transient git fetch failure, or any plan file that `readPlans` rejects. `readPlans` rejects malformed JSON, a schema other than `aayudha.mission.plan/v1` (for example, a plan written by a newer binary), and a path mismatch.

In those cases `lockRefused(err)` is false, so `completeStory` returns the error. `runShip` then exits after the merge, before it writes `ship.json`, the audit entry, and the actions checkpoint. A second `aayu ship` refuses an already-merged PR at Line 159, so the ship record cannot be written later. A malformed plan for any one Feature causes this on every ship in the repository.

The Outcome comment never changes a locked body. That makes it a safe fallback for both a refusal and a failed lock read. Give the lock-read failure its own error type so `completeStory` can detect it.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>
<dl>
<dd>

```diff
--- "a/internal/cli/ship.go"
+++ "b/internal/cli/ship.go"
@@ -1031,9 +1031,10 @@
 		func(ctx context.Context) (any, error) {
 			_, _, err := c.REST.Issues.Update(ctx, owner, name, story, gh.UpdateIssueRequest{Body: &body})
 			return nil, err
-		}); lockRefused(err) {
+		}); lockRefused(err) || lockUnread(err) {
 		// A running mission locks the story's body (Story #1013): the Outcome goes in a comment, and the body stays as locked.
+		// When the locks cannot be read after the merge, the comment is the safe place too: the merge already happened.
 		return wrapExternal(postComment(ctx, c, repo, story, "github.comment.outcome", "### Outcome\n\n"+strings.TrimSpace(out.String())+"\n"))
 	} else if err != nil {
 		return Wrap(ExitExternal, err)
 	}
```

In `internal/cli/missionlock.go`, wrap the lock-read failure in `lockGuard.RoundTrip` in a typed error (for example, `lockReadError`). Add a `lockUnread(err)` helper that uses `errors.As`, in the same way as `lockRefused`.
